reason: The text contains a clear complaint by Moses (a Hebrew leader) about the people. In the passage וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר מֹשֶׁ֔ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר הֵ֤ן בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֹֽא־ שָׁמְע֣וּ אֵלַ֔י, Moses explicitly tells God that the children of Israel did not listen to him, expressing dissatisfaction with the people's failure to heed his message. This constitutes a leader complaining about the people.
